about: Measured from 60 raw IR frames (GREY 400x400) of this laptop's HP IR camera, 2026-11-02, with the helper's own CLAHE (clipLimit 2, 8x8 tiles) and 8-bin histogram. Darkness is the share of CLAHE pixels in the darkest bin (the helper's 'darkness'); mean is the raw frame's mean (0-255). The emitter strobes: every other frame is unlit. The raw frames are not committed.
note: no unlit frame is exactly 100% dark: sensor noise survives CLAHE in a few hundred pixels
